target_subjects.computer: AI and generated information; Project plans and versions; Documentation; Showcase and reflection
target_subjects.skills: Budgeting and priorities; Planning steps and supplies; Independent task demonstration; Life-skills portfolio

guide: Eight core subjects. Monday/Wednesday: Math, Physical Sciences, Art, Life Sciences. Tuesday/Thursday: ELA (including Spanish), Social Studies, Computer Science, Life Skills. Friday: review or module exams, projects, independent study, field trips, and catch-up. Use parent-guided printed readings; videos and Khan support are optional.
standards: Original documented Mississippi/grade-level targets are retained. The added family-defined subjects have an explicit introductory scope and activity/assessment map; no blanket standards-certification claim is made.
sources: Core Knowledge, the saved publisher library, Scratch Foundation, CS Unplugged, USDA, FDIC, AAR, Advocates for Youth, and original VenvLearning course booklets.
